task.name: Task
task.createDescription: A site visit, a tasting, a deadline or a note to yourself. Only the type is required. A task can name rooms and set them aside, but it is never an order.
task.listDescription: Site visits, tastings, deadlines and notes, with or without a customer and a time, before or beside an order.
task.emptyDescription: Create a task for a site visit, a tasting, a deadline or a note to yourself.
task.createTypeDescription: A task type is what you call a kind of task, like Site visit or Headcount due. You can add its own fields later under Types.
task.archiveConfirm: {name} is removed from the calendar, the lists and My work.
task.addToOrderDescription: Add the task to one of the customer's orders. It can belong to one order at a time.
task.editOrderDescription: Move the task to another of the customer's orders, or remove it from its order.
task.customerUnlinksOrder: With another customer, or none, the task leaves its order.

section.title: Tasks
section.orderEmpty: No tasks on this order yet.

calendar.legendText: Outlined: a task or a room it holds, never a booking

rooms.title: Rooms

holdHint.BOOK: Blocks the room for this period. Nobody else can book it.
holdHint.PREBOOK: Sets the room aside for this period. It can still be booked by others.
holdHint.RELATED: Only names the room. Nothing is held.

rooms.dialogDescription: Choose how the task uses the room. A booked or prebooked room has its own period, which does not have to match the due time. Marking the task done releases it.
rooms.createHint: Name the rooms the task is about, or set them aside while you wait for an answer.
rooms.rowInvalid: This room can't be saved for that period. Check the period; a booked room may already be taken.
